title: Card Info section should show the currently selected card, not the most recently hovered one
summary: **Description of New Feature** Currently, the Card Info widget shows the information for the card that was most recently hovered. This creates an issue where using the "view transformation" or scrolling the description textbox for a specific card required navigating through a maze of other cards to not accidentally hover something. My proposed solution would be for the widget to keep displaying the card that is currently selected, or the leftmost/righmost selected card when multiple cards are selected. Ideally, when another card is hovered, the Card Info widget will display the hovered card information, but when it stops being hovered it goes back to the selected card instead of staying on the most recently hovered. **Additional Context** The change would make it much easier to use the "view transformation" function. In the example below, navigating through the whole board (possibly two if you are playing as 4) to the button is tedious, especially if cards are being played at the moment. To see the transformation of "Hadana's Climb" you have to move the cursor slowly to avoid hovering anyhing, and if you fail you have to start over. Sort of like a minigame. Locking the information on the card that is currently selected would fix this issue.

title: Frustrating permission ask
summary: I use Material ONLY to connect a device of mine over the LAN. Eventhough the app CAN and DOES work fine; connecting to my device, showing and reading files, it keeps asking the same PHONE permissions with every folder and file browsed; This permission is for the phone storage which I don't use anyways. I can browse the files on my device over the local area network which is what need to do. But this triggered permission ask is SO FRUSTRATING popping up with every folder you browse even though they are not related to the phone storage at all. It is also breaking the app usage and experience; because when you browse and play a video over the LAN device, the video STOPS playing because the permission is popped up again in the background after 10-15 seconds. I removed all the phone related paths from the "Standard folders" settings. I have hidden all phone related paths from "Storage" setting. I have set my "Default Folder" to a folder on the LAN device. I have changed the "Root access mode" to "Normal access". and it is STILL asking the permission as I browse. It DOES NOT NEED to "manage all files" especially on my "phone" when all the user wants is to merely browse their LAN device which they connect with credentials anyway (so permission is already given on connection). Please fix this.
